rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a blastocyst consistent with reported 3AB, with compact ICM and looser TE; appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment. Minor overstatement of visible features such as zona thinning/expansion detail and absence of degeneration.

Integrates age, AMH, day-5 status, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, diagnosis, and first-cycle context well, and correctly emphasizes that morphology does not resolve ploidy risk at age 36.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis. Slight weakness is a somewhat broad/optimistic implantation range and mild overemphasis on lifestyle factors relative to embryo/ploidy determinants.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice: single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, avoidance of unsupported add-ons, and cautious discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat generic timing suggestions and lifestyle comments not central to guideline-based embryo prognosis.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and future-cycle review, including SET, medication adherence, follow-up, and when to revisit PGT-A or further testing. Useful but not highly individualized beyond standard counseling.
